hooks.name: Run engine tests on save
hooks.description: When a source file of the scoring engine is saved, run the engine test suite and report the result in one or two lines.

action.prompt: A file under backend/engine/src was just saved. Run the engine tests with: cd backend/engine && npm test. Tell me in one or two lines whether they pass, and name the failing test if any. Do not edit any rule, weight, floor, threshold or test; only report.
